name: Honeypot.is token honeypot check (api.honeypot.is)
operator: honeypot.is (operator not identified: no legal entity, address or privacy policy published)
tier_rationale: Registry review for P206 cond 5 (2026-11-26): the site and its API terms (docs.honeypot.is/terms, 'Last Update: 2023-12-05') name only 'honeypot.is' as the contracting party - no legal entity, address or privacy policy; honeypot.is/terms and /privacy return the home page. An anonymous operator is tier unknown under the A8 definitions, so goplus_security does not query it (P206 cond 5: 'queried only if its registry review records tier community or higher').
tier_reviewer: batch p2-G09-1 (A8 definitions; P206 cond 5 review)

reliability.justification: Simulated buy/sell on a DEX pair: answers about token contracts only; a wallet and a malformed address both answer 404 'No pairs found' (research C0499, live 2026-11-26).

is_honeypot.title: Honeypot.is /v2/IsHoneypot?address= (token contracts only; 404 'No pairs found' = not applicable)

terms.quote: GoPlus and Honeypot.is terms could not be verified (docs JS-only, 2026-11-26): class 'key-terms'; Honeypot.is is queried only if its registry review records tier community or higher.

is_honeypot.notes: Quote: binding council text (P206 cond 5). The API terms (2023-12-05) forbid resale and making the API or its functionalities available to third parties and say nothing about business use. Research C0499 (verified_live 404 for a wallet): 200 for a token (token, summary{risk, riskLevel, flags}, simulationSuccess, honeypotResult{isHoneypot}, simulationResult{buyTax, sellTax, transferTax}). Live headers 2026-11-26: x-ratelimit-limit 50 per ~5 s window. NOT queried while this provider's tier is 'unknown' (goplus_security keeps a parser and a tier gate only).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-1 (P206). Registered so the host has an owner and the review is recorded; no module declares this source while the tier is 'unknown' (an unknown-tier source would also force goplus_security out of the default set, A3).
